create_gmensemble: create a GMEnsemble object with GMParam config and median or mean ensemble type
train_gmensemble: train a GMEnsemble on a dictionary or list of TimeSeriesData objects with validation split
predict_gmensemble: predict forecasts for time series using a trained GMEnsemble with specified forecast steps
save_gmensemble: save a trained GMEnsemble model to a pickle file using joblib serialization
load_gmensemble: load a trained GMEnsemble model from a pickle file and restore all gm_models
evaluate_gmensemble: evaluate a GMEnsemble model performance on test time series and return a pandas DataFrame
